name: auth-passkey-handshake
title: Auth Passkey Handshake
description: A passkey sign-in built around a dial of sixty ticks: a sweep while the browser looks for a passkey, a draining countdown ring while you confirm on your device, then every tick lights up as the signature is verified. A live checklist shows each step of the ceremony.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
